review.notes: Full token-level pass of all 17 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; pages 1, 6, 7 and 15 were rendered and visually checked. All three printed footnote bodies were dropped by OCR while their superscript markers survived; the remaining token deltas are soft-hyphen line-break splits that the markdown joins correctly. arXiv margin stamps and run-in paragraph headings left as-is.
